manifest.name: web-investigator
manifest.description: Studio cockpit for a web-investigator net: browse what was crawled, read the analyses, and record decisions.
manifest.author: AgenticNetOS

readme:
# Web Investigator (application)

A generic-surface Studio application over the web-investigator capability's places. Runtime places are model-global, so installing this into the model that runs the net binds every store to the LIVE crawl data — the app's own session net is just another canvas over the same places.

Understand: findings by recency, landscape analyses, the category rollup, crawl-health insights, and the owner's own inventory. Decide: accept a recommendation into the article-task queue, dismiss it, mark a finding as already covered, queue a URL or search query into the crawl, or request an immediate rollup run (executed by the net's t-scout-app-run lane, never by the app itself).

applicationManifest.name: web-investigator
applicationManifest.description: Browse what the investigation crawled — findings by recency, analyses, gaps, crawl health — and record decisions: accept recommendations as article tasks, dismiss, mark covered, steer the crawl.

stores.description: The investigation definition: topic, categories, scoring terms, host rules. Edit via the Token Workbench, not here.
Findings published within the brief's brand-new window. The most urgent competitor signal.
Findings published within the brief's recent window.
Older findings. The view shows the newest slice; query the place for the full corpus.
Landscape analyses: owned angles, freshness, fresh signal, gaps, own position, recommendations.
Deterministic per-category rollup with recency split, own-coverage and the facts token the digest reads.
Crawl-health rollups with concrete tuning suggestions.
URLs queued for the crawl. queue-url writes here; the fetch lane consumes.
Search queries for the optional widening lane. queue-query writes here.
The owner's own published articles (slugs only, indexed from the sitemap, never crawled).
Accepted recommendations with their evidence. Drained by the operator or a future writing persona.
Append-only audit of operator decisions: dismissals, covered-marks, task completions.
Run-now requests. The net's own lane consumes these and builds the actual command tokens — the app never executes anything itself.

actions.name: accept-recommendation
actions.description: Turn a digest recommendation (or any finding) into an article task, carrying its evidence.

title.description: Working title of the article to write

rationale.description: Why this, quoting the gap or fresh signal

blobUrn.description: Stored full text of that piece, if any

actions.name: dismiss
actions.description: Reject a recommendation or finding, with the reason on record.

subject.description: URL or recommendation text being dismissed

actions.name: mark-covered
actions.description: Record that a competitor finding is already covered by the owner's site.

url.description: The competitor URL that is covered

ownSlug.description: The owner article that covers it

actions.name: complete-task
actions.description: Close an accepted article task; the task token flips to done atomically.

actions.name: queue-url
actions.description: Queue a URL for the crawl. The running fetch lane picks it up on its next binding.

actions.name: queue-query
actions.description: Queue a search query for the optional widening lane (needs its API key configured).

actions.name: request-run
actions.description: Ask the net to run a rollup now. Its own lane builds and executes the command; the app only records the request.

run.description: taxonomy = category rollup + digest; owned = re-index the owner's sitemap; health = crawl diagnostics

rules: Tasks carry their evidence (rationale, competitorUrl, blobUrn) — read it before writing anything.
Record every outcome through complete-task so the task flips atomically; never edit task tokens directly.
